card.name: Inside foreign and rare word spellings
card.fires_on: Partway through a transliterated or unusual word, usually just after its first letters. Seen in Greek, Sanskrit, Malay and Lao transliterations, and in rare names such as Brugada.

modes.label: Transliterated foreign words
modes.description: Romanized Greek, Sanskrit or Lao terms, often in parentheses after a gloss.

modes.description: Early pieces of uncommon medical names or brand names.
